legacy_pair_gpu: RTX 4090 24 GB on GPU.ai, separate physical worker
configuration: Each baseline/candidate pair uses the same worker and frozen inference/scoring implementation. Both suites use the selected corrected adapter, whose SHA-256 is dfb60b5f56dea06094a73e9de7d8175d70ea9eb252ae8db0cb3ac3721077b504.
scheduling_history: The initial separate evaluation worker was split into concept and legacy work after observed runtimes showed that the combined schedule risked its shutdown deadline. A USD 0.50/hour RTX 3090 offering failed provisioning. A USD 0.22/hour replacement started but CUDA initialization failed before model inference; it was terminated and contributes no model results. The paired legacy evaluation moved to a verified RTX 4090 after the training instance was collected and terminated.
collection: The training archive was checksum-verified and extracted with Python 3.11. The macOS system Python 3.9 collector lacked the requested safe tar extraction interface; no trained weights were lost. Both final evaluation collectors use Python 3.11.
cost_note: Completed training and failed-worker runtime are estimated at USD 3.1235 from provider ready/terminated timestamps and quoted rates. Each remaining evaluation worker has a one-hour USD 0.89 cap. The resulting estimated upper total is USD 4.9035; actual early termination is recorded after completion. These are runtime estimates, not an invoice.
